verdict.rationale: Okta's docs confirm SCIM as a defined schema/RESTful API for CRUD on users and groups, with a dedicated guide series for building SCIM provisioning integrations, which directly supports auto-provisioning of users/groups into downstream apps on access assignment. However, evidence lacks detail on entitlement push specifically, real-time timing guarantees, or hands-on/independent confirmation that provisioning is instant and reliable in practice. missing for 10: entitlement-level provisioning detail, real-time/timing evidence, independent or hands-on verification of push behavior.
